description: Greetings, warrior.  Your skill grows, but there is more to your profession than you may believe.  To further progress, you must soon find a teacher.
The warrior Elanaria dwells in Darnassus, at the Warrior's Terrace.  She can instruct you.
completion: I bid you greetings, <name>.  Your name rings loudly in Darnassus, for you show promise.  But we shall soon see if you possess the strength of will to follow the path of the warrior.
